title: The Fan Clan Charitable Estate
synopsis: Fan Zhongyan was a Northern Song statesman and scholar renowned for his charitable endeavors and moral integrity. A reform-minded official, he worked tirelessly to improve the welfare of the people.

series.title: The Splendor of the Song Dynasty

fullText.simplified:
范氏义庄——宋代家族慈善典范

    提起范仲淹，中国学生的反应总是两极分化。有人敬仰他的文章有思想、启迪人心，而有人则因为他的作品《岳阳楼记》成了学校的“背诵必修课”而对他心生畏惧。这足以证明他在文学史上的巨大影响力。然而，他留给历史的印记远不止于一篇被千万人熟背的文章。
    范仲淹是北宋年间的文学家和政治家。他早年因为父亲去世，生活贫困。在求学时因为吃不起饭总觉得饥饿难忍，于是他就把米煮成粥放一夜。第二天粥凝结成一块饼，他再把粥饼切开，早上晚上各一半，搭配咸菜吃，就感觉吃饱了。这样的生活持续了三年，直到他在科举考试中成功，获得了官职。在北宋时期，文官的地位比较高，能够向皇帝提出建议。范仲淹正是赶上了这样的时代，他有才华、敢说话，还能带兵打仗，而且做人公正，因此很快就成为了朝廷重臣。在担任官职期间，他始终关心百姓的生活，推行了一系列改革，其中最著名的是“庆历新政”。范仲淹希望通过提升官员素质、减少特权、加强地方管理，让国家更加稳定和公平。虽然这项改革最终未能全面实行，但它为后来的政治改革提供了重要参考。
    范仲淹不仅在政治上有突出贡献，而且非常关注社会公益。他提出了“先天下之忧而忧，后天下之乐而乐”的理念，意思是有责任心的读书人应该先考虑国家和百姓的困难，等到大家都过上好日子后，自己才能安心享乐。这种精神成为中国传统士大夫的典范，影响深远。
    晚年，范仲淹仍心系族人。他和族人共同拿出多年积蓄，购买了一千亩田地，称为“范氏义庄”，并确立了详细的管理制度：
    一、义庄的田地只低价租给本族人耕种，不能出售，这确保了家族资产的稳定性；
    二、每年收获的粮食一部分拿出来分给族人满足基本生活需要，一部分存储作为备用基金；
    三、备用基金用于生老病死、婚丧嫁娶费用，如果族中有人才华出众，义庄须无条件资助其教育和科举费用；
    四、设立两个职位，分别负责日常经营和财务管理，两个职位不能由同一人担任，确保透明公正；
    五、每年年底公开账目，接受全族监督，防止腐败。
    这一超前的制度设计，让义庄得以运转了八百多年，跨越宋、元、明、清四朝，并对后世的慈善机构和家族管理体系产生了深远影响。范仲淹的家族传承了他的精神，代代都有读书人。
    金钱易逝，精神长存。范仲淹和义庄的智慧仍在启迪当代中国人。
fullText.traditional:
范氏義莊——宋代家族慈善典範

    提起范仲淹，中國學生的反應總是兩極分化。有人敬仰他的文章有思想、啟迪人心，而有人則因為他的作品《岳陽樓記》成了學校的“背誦必修課”而對他心生畏懼。這足以證明他在文學史上的巨大影響力。然而，他留給歷史的印記遠不止於一篇被千萬人熟背的文章。
    范仲淹是北宋年間的文學家和政治家。他早年因為父親去世，生活貧困。在求學時因為吃不起飯總覺得飢餓難忍，於是他就把米煮成粥放一夜。第二天粥凝結成一塊餅，他再把粥餅切開，早上晚上各一半，搭配鹹菜吃，就感覺吃飽了。這樣的生活持續了三年，直到他在科舉考試中成功，獲得了官職。在北宋時期，文官的地位比較高，能夠向皇帝提出建議。范仲淹正是趕上了這樣的時代，他有才華、敢說話，還能帶兵打仗，而且做人公正，因此很快就成為了朝廷重臣。在擔任官職期間，他始終關心百姓的生活，推行了一系列改革，其中最著名的是“慶曆新政”。范仲淹希望通過提昇官員素質、減少特權、加強地方管理，讓國家更加穩定和公平。雖然這項改革最終未能全面實行，但它為後來的政治改革提供了重要參考。
    范仲淹不僅在政治上有突出貢獻，而且非常關注社會公益。他提出了“先天下之憂而憂，後天下之樂而樂”的理念，意思是有責任心的讀書人應該先考慮國家和百姓的困難，等到大家都過上好日子後，自己才能安心享樂。這種精神成為中國傳統士大夫的典範，影響深遠。
    晚年，范仲淹仍心繫族人。他和族人共同拿出多年積蓄，購買了一千畝田地，稱為“范氏義莊”，並確立了詳細的管理制度：
    一、義莊的田地只低價租給本族人耕種，不能出售，這確保了家族資產的穩定性；
    二、每年收穫的糧食一部分拿出來分給族人滿足基本生活需要，一部分存儲作為備用基金；
    三、備用基金用于生老病死、婚喪嫁娶費用，如果族中有人才華出眾，義莊須無條件資助其教育和科舉費用；
    四、設立兩個職位，分別負責日常經營和財務管理，兩個職位不能由同一人擔任，確保透明公正；
    五、每年年底公開賬目，接受全族監督，防止腐敗。
    這一超前的制度設計，讓義莊得以運轉了八百多年，跨越宋、元、明、清四朝，並對後世的慈善機構和家族管理體系產生了深遠影響。范仲淹的家族傳承了他的精神，代代都有讀書人。
    金錢易逝，精神長存。范仲淹和義莊的智慧仍在啟迪當代中國人。

sentence_translations: The Fan Clan Charitable Estate: A Model of Clan Charity From the Song dynasty
When Fan Zhongyan is mentioned, the reactions of Chinese students are always polarized.
Some admire his writings for their thoughtfulness and inspiration.
Others are fearful of him because his work “Record of Yueyang Tower” has become a set text that is mandatory to know by heart in schools.
This is enough to prove his tremendous influence in the history of literature.
However, the mark he left on history goes far beyond a text memorized by millions.
Fan Zhongyan was a writer and politician during the Northern Song dynasty.
In his early years, he lived in poverty due to the death of his father.
When he was studying, he often felt unbearably hungry because he couldn’t afford food.
Therefore, he would cook rice into congee and leave it overnight.
The next day, the porridge would have solidified into a cake, which he then cut up.
He would eat one half in the morning and the other in the evening, paired with pickled vegetables. This made him feel full.
This life continued for three years until he succeeded in the imperial examination and obtained an official position.
During the Northern Song dynasty, the status of civil officials was relatively high, and they were able to offer suggestions to the emperor.
Fan Zhongyan happened to live in such an era.
He was talented, outspoken, and capable of leading troops in battle.
He also conducted himself with fairness, so he soon became a high-ranking official in the court.
During his tenure in office, he consistently cared about the lives of the people and implemented a series of reforms.
The most famous of these were the “Qingli Reforms”.
Fan Zhongyan hoped to improve the quality of officials, reduce privileges, and strengthen local governance ..
.. to make the country more stable and equitable.
Although these reforms were ultimately not fully implemented, ..
.. they provided an important reference for subsequent political reforms.
Fan Zhongyan not only made outstanding contributions in politics but also paid great attention to social welfare.
He proposed the idea of “worrying about the troubles of the world before others do and enjoying the joys of the world only after others do”.
This means that responsible scholars should first consider the difficulties of the country and the people.
Only after everyone is living a good life can they then enjoy themselves with peace of mind.
This spirit became a model for traditional Chinese scholar-officials and had a far-reaching influence.
In his later years, Fan Zhongyan still cared deeply for his clan.
He and his clan members pooled years of savings to purchase a thousand mu of land.
They named it the “Fan Clan Charitable Estate” and established a detailed management system:
1. The land of the charitable estate was rented at a low price only to members of the same clan for cultivation and could not be sold.
This ensured the stability of the clan’s assets.
2. A portion of the grain harvested each year was distributed to the clan members to meet basic living needs.
Another portion was stored as a reserve fund.
3. The reserve fund was used for expenses related to birth, aging, illness, and death, as well as weddings and funerals.
If there was anyone in the clan with outstanding talent, ..
.. the charitable estate had to unconditionally support their education and examination expenses.
4. Two positions were established, one responsible for daily operations and the other for financial management.
These two positions could not be held by the same person to ensure transparency and fairness.
5. At the end of each year, the accounts were made public and subjected to the supervision of the entire clan to prevent corruption.
This forward-thinking institutional design allowed the charitable estate to operate for over eight hundred years, ..
.. spanning the Song, Yuan, Ming, and Qing dynasties.
It also had a profound impact on later charitable organizations and clan management systems.
Fan Zhongyan’s family inherited his spirit, with scholars in every generation.
Money is fleeting, but the spirit endures.
The wisdom of Fan Zhongyan and his charitable estate continues to inspire contemporary Chinese people.
